## Changed
- Search shows songs only. YouTube videos (tutorials, clips, kids songs) are gone, and so is the "On YouTube" list
- YouTube Music search finds the songs themselves (the album tracks with their album covers), never music videos
- Spotify songs play the matching song from YouTube Music, looked up as "artist - title"
- No small video window in the corner any more, YouTube only plays the sound

## Fixed
- Spotify search works again: Spotify now allows at most 10 results per request, which broke the search
- Spotify artist pages show the artist's songs again (Spotify removed "top tracks")
- Playlists of other people import again, read from the public Spotify page, with covers per song
- Importing the same playlist twice updates the first one instead of adding a copy
- "Save as playlist" no longer creates an empty playlist when none of the songs are on your server

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates, or install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
